scope: Automated state and synthesis verification; allowed policy set in test browser, blocked cases add a deterministic activation guard around native Web Audio; human listening acceptance remains with user

results.name: Allowed autoplay follows actual loading, rendered model, scan and landing phases exactly once
Blocked autoplay offers an accessible sound control and starts only after a trusted click
Enabling during reveal plays the current phase without replaying missed loading cues
Late activation after the intro never plays stale startup tones
Muting and leaving the intro cancel its tones and remember mute on reload
A missing audio module leaves the full visual arrival and science escape available
Mobile sound control fits the loader and a trusted touch unlocks it
